answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
